name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a saddle or seat, designed to travel on no more than three wheels. An electric two-wheeler that isn't an electric bicycle and can go faster than 30 mph is a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: A saddle or seat, and no more than three wheels on the ground
One that can't exceed 30 mph and needs no gear shifting is regulated as a moped instead
Riders need a motorcycle endorsement on their license; riders under 18 must first pass an approved motorcycle safety course, and older applicants pass a test that includes riding
Every rider and passenger must wear an approved crash helmet, unless 21 or older with $20,000 of first-party medical coverage and, for the operator, two years' endorsement or a safety course
Registered with the Secretary of State
Entitled to full use of a lane; no riding between lines of traffic or more than two abreast
Riders sit astride a permanent seat, carrying no more people than it's built for
